UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src = Get-ChildItem -Path 'darkflame/download' -Recurse -Filter 'MasterServer.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $src) { Write-Output 'MasterServer.exe not found in the download'; exit 1 }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'darkflame/server','darkflame/client' | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem -Path $src.DirectoryName | Where-Object { -not ($_.Name -like '*.ini' -and (Test-Path (Join-Path 'darkflame/server' $_.Name))) } | Copy-Item -Destination 'darkflame/server' -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item -Path 'darkflame/download' -Recurse -Force"

-c "src=$(dirname \"$(find darkflame/download -type f -name MasterServer | head -n 1)\") && [[ -f \"$src/MasterServer\" ]] || { echo 'MasterServer not found in the download'; exit 1; }; mkdir -p darkflame/server darkflame/client && for f in \"$src\"/*; do n=$(basename \"$f\"); if [[ $n == *.ini && -e darkflame/server/$n ]]; then continue; fi; cp -a \"$f\" darkflame/server/; done && chmod +x darkflame/server/MasterServer darkflame/server/AuthServer darkflame/server/ChatServer darkflame/server/WorldServer && rm -rf darkflame/download"
